feeds.title: Women of Egypt Network
feeds.description: Women of Egypt Network was created to empower women and advance gender equality; to change the image of how the West perceives Egyptian women, and to revive the memory of the fantastic women of the Egyptian suffragette movement. The magazine covers various topics such as social issues, women's health, and entrepreneurship.

feeds.title: Egyptian Streets » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: News, society, culture, arts, politics, technology, travel, and other 'stories that matter' related to Egypt and the Middle East.

feeds.title: Identity Magazine » Lifestyle
feeds.description: Identity is a monthly fashion and lifestyle magazine bringing you the latest and hottest trends in Egypt and worldwide! Identity delivers entertainment, fashion, and all the latest happenings from all over the world.

feeds.title: Ancient Egypt Alive Blog
feeds.description: We are an organization devoted to inspiring passion for Ancient Egypt. Our goals are simple: To educate, entertain, inspire - and breathe life into the exciting history of the land of the pharaohs.

feeds.title: Curls en Route Blog
feeds.description: Curls en Route is a solo travel blog by Egyptian traveler, Nadine Arab. Sharing her adventures, guides, and travel tips and tricks.

feeds.title: Egyptian Chronicles
feeds.description: A blog about Egypt and the Middle East as well as Egyptian affairs including politics and history. Explore the shifting Dunes and Dynamics of Egypt's Political and Cultural landscape from a local perspective. Author Zainab Mohammed is an Egyptian Blogger who 'who lives in the present with the glories of the past and hopes in a better future for herself and for her country'.

feeds.title: Egypt Time Travel Blog
feeds.description: Check our Egypt Blog articles to discover all you need to know about Egypt before planning your trip to Egypt. Egypt Time Travel is an Egypt travel agency established in the year 2001. We strive to create travel experiences that add flavours to the life of our clients and experience the wonders of Egypt with extension experts and Egyptologists.

feeds.title: Jakada Tours Egypt Blog
feeds.description: Discover all you need to know about the hidden secrets of Egypt - Jakada Tours Egypt Blog is your travel guide to Egypt, taking you on a virtual tour to some of the most sought-after places in the country and also imparting crucial travel tips & ideas in the process. Jakada Tours Egypt is one of the best tour operators in Egypt.

feeds.title: Egypt Adventures Travel Blog
feeds.description: Gus Gleiter is the founder of Egypt Adventures Travel. His fascination with Egypt started after learning about pharaohs and pyramids in elementary school. Now he and his team create curated travel experiences for adventurers who want to explore the land of the pharaohs. They help you with a fully customized itinerary with some guidance.

feeds.title: The Local's Guide To Cairo Blog
feeds.description: Our local Egypt guide and blog. Discusses the best restaurants, bars, places to stay, sightseeing, beaches, cities, and more in Egypt. Gather local travel tips, itineraries, recommendations, and insider information about all things Egypt.

feeds.title: The Egyptian Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: I am Annie. I've always loved to cook and I've always loved learning about my Egyptian heritage. As the first generation born outside of Egypt, my connection to the country has been primarily through food, not language. I created this blog to introduce people to my favourite foods that are found in Egypt, and explain the historical or cultural background of each dish or ingredient.

feeds.title: Living in Egypt
feeds.description: I am Maryanne. Egypt isn't what it appears to be in the media...but that's no real surprise since not much is. I moved here in the late 80's from Toronto, Canada, with my Canadian/Egyptian husband, my son, and my daughter. The children adapted quickly and we decided that this country was a good place to live. Now I wouldn't change my home for anything.

feeds.title: United Guides Travel Blog
feeds.description: The United Guides Egyptian Travel Blog showcases the best ways to explore Egypt and its Historic sites. Visitors will find everything they need here to easily plan a trip to Egypt and get there on time without any problems. United Guides Travel is part of United Guides for Tourism Investment And Project Management owned by the Egyptian government.

feeds.title: Mr & Mrs Egypt
feeds.description: Our blog is designed to entertain and inform anyone considering a trip to Egypt. Read our Egypt travel guides to find out more about visiting our beautiful country. Mr & Mrs. Egypt is an Egyptian Tour operating company founded by Carol and Atef that offers attractive Egypt Tour Packages and Custom Egypt Tours to visitors.

feeds.title: FTS Travels Blog
feeds.description: The FTS Travels Blog gives you a taste of the Middle East with Travel tips, Tourist information and answers many basic questions for would-be visitors. FTS Travels is a pioneer in online Tourism in the Middle East and Africa. We also participate with its touristic activities in development and improving tourism business in Egypt.
